title: Listening or Reading? Evaluating Speech Awareness in Chain-of-Thought Speech-to-Text Translation
abstract: arXiv:2510.03115v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Speech-to-Text Translation (S2TT) systems built from Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) and Text-to-Text Translation (T2TT) modules face two major limitations: error propagation and the inability to exploit prosodic or other acoustic cues. Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting has recently been introduced, with the expectation that jointly accessing speech and transcription will overcome these issues. Analyzing CoT through attribution methods, robustness evaluations with corrupted transcripts, and prosody-awareness, we find that it largely mirrors cascaded behavior, relying mainly on transcripts while barely leveraging speech. Simple training interventions, such as adding Direct S2TT data or noisy transcript injection, enhance robustness and increase speech attribution. These findings challenge the assumed advantages of CoT and highlight the need for architectures that explicitly integrate acoustic information into translation.

translated_title: 听还是读？评估思维链语音到文本翻译中的语音感知
translated_abstract: 语音到文本翻译（S2TT）系统由自动语音识别（ASR）和文本到文本翻译（T2TT）模块构建，面临两个主要限制：错误传播以及无法利用韵律或其他声学线索。最近引入了思维链（CoT）提示，期望通过同时访问语音和转录来克服这些问题。通过使用归因方法、对损坏转录的鲁棒性评估以及韵律感知来分析CoT，我们发现它在很大程度上模仿了级联行为，主要依赖转录而几乎不利用语音。简单的训练干预，如添加直接S2TT数据或噪声转录注入，增强了鲁棒性并增加了语音归因。这些发现挑战了CoT的假设优势，并强调了需要明确将声学信息整合到翻译中的架构。
tldr: 思维链提示在语音到文本翻译中主要依赖转录文本而几乎不利用语音信息，其假设的优势受到质疑，需通过训练干预或架构改进来增强声学信息的整合。
en_tdlr: Chain-of-Thought prompting in speech-to-text translation primarily relies on transcripts with minimal speech usage, challenging its assumed advantages and necessitating explicit acoustic integration through training interventions or architectural improvements.
